keywords: Partition action – co-ownership – undivided shares – pedigree – allotment of shares – accuracy of share determination – survey plan evidence – uncontested defendants – admission of title – non-contesting parties – entitlement to larger share – limited appellate challenge in partition decree – lack of contest on merits – dismissal of appeal – finality of partition judgment – survey plan identification – Section 25 Partition Act principles (implied) – burden of proof in share variation – failure to establish error in allocation.
legistation: Partition Act (Sri Lanka) – principles governing partition, determination of shares, and finality of decrees; Civil Procedure Code – provisions relating to partition proceedings and appellate intervention; Evidence Ordinance – admissions by parties and effect of uncontested facts; relevant procedural principles on co-ownership and survey plan reliance in partition actions.
